explanation: Count distinct reduced fractions p/q with p dividing 14 and q dividing 12. Numerators 1 and 7 each allow all 6 denominators (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12); numerators 2 and 14 each allow only the 2 odd denominators (1, 3). Thus there are 6+6+2+2=16 positive candidates, and including their negatives gives 32.
